authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant structural artifacts typical of AI generation. The most severe defect is the fusion of the flamingos' legs in the water; individual limb boundaries are lost, creating a 'melted' appearance where legs merge into each other or the water surface. The animal pose auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk level with 90% of keypoints having low confidence, confirming widespread anatomical uncertainty. Additionally, the croissant floats with unnatural buoyancy and lacks appropriate wetting effects, appearing pasted onto the scene. While the upper bodies and heads of the flamingos are rendered with reasonable detail (correct bill shape, plumage color), the lower body collapse severely impacts authenticity.
key_defects: High keypoint uncertainty indicating anatomical instability
